observations.body: Jesus calls for trust, speaks of his Father’s house and prepared place, identifies himself as way, truth, and life, answers Philip about seeing the Father, and speaks of works and asking in his name.

payload.posture: Read John 14:1–14 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus calls for trust, speaks of his Father’s house and prepared place, identifies himself as way, truth, and life, answers Philip about seeing the Father, and speaks of works and asking in his name. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
